# Brains Super Speciality Hospital

> Brains Super Speciality Hospital (Bangalore, India) is a tertiary healthcare center specializing in neurosurgery, neurology, spine care, and multidisciplinary super-speciality medical services, founded and led by renowned neurosurgeon Dr. N K Venkataramana.

## Core Specialities & Centers of Excellence

- [Neurosurgery](https://brainshospital.com/Neurosurgery.html): Best neurosurgery hospital in Bangalore; minimally invasive neurosurgery, endoscopic neurosurgery, skull base and cerebrovascular surgery in Bangalore.
- [Brain Tumor Treatment & Surgery](https://brainshospital.com/brain-tumor-treatment-bangalore.html): Comprehensive brain tumour treatment in Bangalore, brain tumour surgery, and neuro-oncology.
- [Brain Tumor Wing](https://brainshospital.com/Brain-Tumor-Wing.html): Dedicated centre for adult and pediatric brain tumour treatment and surgery in Bangalore.
- [Spine Care & Spine Surgery](https://brainshospital.com/spine-care-and-ortho-care-hospital-bangalore.html): Best spine hospital in Bangalore, spine surgeon in Bangalore, minimally invasive spine surgery, spinal decompression, and spine rehabilitation.
- [Stroke & Brain Attack Clinic](https://brainshospital.com/stroke-brain-attack-clinic.html): Stroke treatment hospital in Bangalore, stroke specialist in Bangalore, 24/7 stroke emergency treatment.
- [Epilepsy Treatment](https://brainshospital.com/Epilepsy-Treatment.html): Diagnostic evaluation, EEG/video EEG monitoring, medical management, and epilepsy surgery.
- [Paediatric Neuroscience](https://brainshospital.com/Paediatric-Neuroscience.html): Paediatric neurosurgeon in Bangalore, paediatric brain surgery, and premier paediatric neuroscience centre in India.
- [Children's Brain Tumour Treatment](https://brainshospital.com/brain-tumors-in-children.html): Specialized care for paediatric brain and spinal tumours.
- [Critical Care Hospital](https://brainshospital.com/Critical-care-hospital-bangalore.html): 24/7 dedicated neuro critical care hospital in Bangalore and multi-disciplinary ICU.
- [Emergency & Trauma Care](https://brainshospital.com/Emergency-and-Trauma-Care.html): 24 hour emergency hospital in Bangalore, trauma care hospital, brain trauma treatment, and spinal trauma treatment.
- [Parkinson's Disease Clinic](https://brainshospital.com/Parkinson-Disease.html): Comprehensive Parkinson's disease treatment in Bangalore, movement disorders, and neuro rehabilitation.
- [Heart Care (Cardiology)](https://brainshospital.com/Heart-Care.html): Cardiology hospital in Bangalore, cardiac diagnostics, and emergency cardiovascular care.
- [General Medicine](https://brainshospital.com/General-Medicine.html): General medicine doctor in Bangalore, chronic disease management, and internal medicine.
- [Vascular Surgery & Care](https://brainshospital.com/Vascular-Care.html): Best vascular surgery hospital in Bangalore for peripheral vascular diseases and varicose veins.
- [Orthopaedic Care & Joint Replacement](https://brainshospital.com/joint-and-bone-care-hospital.html): Orthopaedic hospital in Bangalore, advanced joint replacement, and fracture management.
- [Surgical & Medical Oncology](https://brainshospital.com/Surgical-Oncology.html): Surgical oncology hospital in Bangalore and medical oncology services.
- [Lung Care & Pulmonology](https://brainshospital.com/Lung-Care.html): Pulmonology hospital in Bangalore, management of respiratory diseases and pulmonary medicine.

## Patient Services & Contact Information

- [Emergency Services](https://brainshospital.com/Emergency-and-Trauma-Care.html): 24/7 emergency & trauma care located at 192, T Mariyappa Road, Lalbagh, Siddapura, Jayanagar 1st Block, Bengaluru, Karnataka 560011 (Near Lalbagh Bangalore).
- [Dr N K Venkataramana - Founder](https://brainshospital.com/founder.html): Renowned senior neurosurgeon with over 50,000 surgeries to date.
- [Book an Appointment](https://app.brainshospital.com): Book neurosurgeon appointment in Bangalore and online brain surgery consultation.
- [International Patients](https://brainshospital.com/INTERNATIONAL-PATIENTS.html): International patient neurosurgery hospital in India for advanced brain and spine treatment.
